description: Establish the in-sandbox verification baseline for the embedding/knowledge modules. The full pytest suite cannot run here (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY blocks installing numpy/hypothesis/aiohttp). Confirm the targeted test path that DOES work: the pyenv 3.11.15 interpreter (pytest 9.1.1 preinstalled) running focused tests that bypass the heavy root conftest, with the vendored Llama class faked (as test/test_embeddings.py already does). This feature does not modify product code; it verifies the tooling later features rely on and records the exact commands. Independent of later features but MUST run first so subsequent features have a known-good verification harness.
steps: Confirm the interpreter: `~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m pytest --version` prints pytest 9.1.1. (python3.12 exists but has no pytest; default `python` is not on PATH.)

Confirm the modules under test import with stdlib only: `cd /projects/sandbox/KiroCrew && PYTHONPATH=src ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -c 'import kiro_crew.embeddings, kiro_crew.knowledge.embedder; print("import ok")'`.

Confirm the full suite is NOT runnable and document why: `cd /projects/sandbox/KiroCrew && PYTHONPATH=src ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m pytest test/test_embeddings.py -q 2>&1 | head` fails at conftest import (ModuleNotFoundError: hypothesis). This is the expected sandbox limitation, not a regression.

Establish the working targeted-test pattern: create a throwaway test file under a scratch dir (e.g. /tmp/kc_probe/test_probe.py with its own empty conftest.py) that imports kiro_crew.embeddings and asserts a trivial fact (e.g. LlamaCppEmbedder exists), then run it with `PYTHONPATH=src ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m pytest /tmp/kc_probe/test_probe.py -p no:cacheprovider -o addopts='' -q`. Confirm it passes. Delete the scratch dir afterward. This proves later features can validate code with fakes without the heavy conftest.
Record all confirmed commands and their outputs in this feature's findings field so FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 reuse them verbatim.
acceptance_criteria: A scratch pytest file that fakes/avoids heavy deps runs green under the pyenv 3.11.15 interpreter with -o addopts='' and its own confcutdir, proving the targeted-test harness works.
findings documents the exact working test command and the confirmed sandbox limitation (full suite unavailable).
verification: Run the three commands in steps 1-3 and the scratch test in step 4; confirm outcomes match acceptance criteria.
No product source files are modified by this feature (git status shows only .agents/ scratch, if anything).
findings:
VERIFICATION BASELINE CONFIRMED (all commands run from repo root /projects/sandbox/KiroCrew).

--- Interpreter (step 1) ---
Command: ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m pytest --version
Output: pytest 9.1.1
(python3.12 exists but has NO pytest; default `python` is not on PATH via pyenv shim. Use the explicit pyenv 3.11.15 path.)

--- Module import sanity (step 2) ---
Command: PYTHONPATH=src ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -c 'import kiro_crew.embeddings, kiro_crew.knowledge.embedder; print("import ok")'
Output: import ok  (exit 0). Modules under test import with the standard library only.

--- Full suite is NOT runnable (step 3, expected sandbox limitation, NOT a regression) ---
Command: PYTHONPATH=src ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m pytest test/test_embeddings.py -q
Output: ImportError while loading conftest '/projects/sandbox/KiroCrew/test/conftest.py'.
  test/conftest.py:15: in <module>
      from hypothesis import HealthCheck, settings
  E   ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'hypothesis'
Cause: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode blocks PyPI (pip install returns 403), so hypothesis/numpy/aiohttp cannot be installed. The root conftest.py imports them at module import time, so ANY test collected under test/ fails at conftest load. This is a documented constraint, not a bug to fix. Do NOT attempt `pip install` or `make build`.

--- WORKING TARGETED-TEST HARNESS (step 4) ---
Pattern: place the focused test in a scratch dir that has its OWN (empty) conftest.py, and pass --confcutdir pointing at that dir so pytest does NOT walk up into the heavy root conftest. Also pass -o addopts='' to clear the pyproject/setup.cfg default addopts.

IMPORTANT SANDBOX NOTE: the fs_write tool and the execute_bash shell do NOT share the same /tmp mount, so a scratch file written to /tmp via fs_write is invisible to the pyenv interpreter launched from bash. Create the scratch dir INSIDE the workspace instead (e.g. .agents/kc_probe/, which is untracked) so both the file tools and the interpreter see it. Alternatively create /tmp/kc_probe entirely via bash. The .agents/kc_probe path was used and verified.

Exact confirmed command (run from repo root):
  PYTHONPATH=src ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m pytest .agents/kc_probe/test_probe.py -p no:cacheprovider --confcutdir=.agents/kc_probe -o addopts='' -q
With .agents/kc_probe/conftest.py = empty file and .agents/kc_probe/test_probe.py:
  import kiro_crew.embeddings as emb
  def test_embedder_class_exists():
      assert hasattr(emb, 'LlamaCppEmbedder')
Output: `.` then `1 passed, 1 warning in 0.12s` (exit 0). The only warning is a harmless 'Unknown config option: looponfailroots' from the repo pytest config; it does not affect the run.

NOTE on --confcutdir: it is REQUIRED. Without it, pytest still walks up from the test file into test/conftest.py? No - it walks up to the repo root conftest and rootdir conftest, which triggers the hypothesis ImportError. The empty conftest.py in the scratch dir alone is not sufficient; --confcutdir=<scratch dir> is what stops the upward walk. (pytest 9 requires --confcutdir to point at an existing directory or it errors 'must be a directory'.)

Scratch dir was deleted after the run; `git status` shows only the untracked .agents/ task directory and NO product source changes. This feature modified no product files.

FOR FEAT-002 / FEAT-003 reuse verbatim: (1) interpreter = ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python; (2) always PYTHONPATH=src; (3) put new tests in a scratch dir with an empty conftest.py and run with -p no:cacheprovider --confcutdir=<scratchdir> -o addopts='' -q; (4) fake the vendored Llama class as test/test_embeddings.py does - never load a real model or hit the network; (5) create scratch files inside the workspace (not /tmp via fs_write) due to the /tmp mount mismatch.
